project.title: 김씨 생존기: 무인도
project.oneLinePitch: 무인도에 조난된 김씨가 내용물을 알 수 없는 수색 오브젝트를 직접 뒤져 필요한 물건만 가방에 챙기고, 상태가 영구히 변하는 일곱 지역과 다층 캠프를 오가며 여러 방법으로 탈출하거나 행동 기반 코믹 엔딩을 맞는 2D 생존 게임.

statusVocabulary.DONE: Current build and current evidence satisfy the submission requirement without a remaining human-only decision.
statusVocabulary.PARTIAL: A base implementation or evidence exists, but a required connection, state, surface or current probe remains.
statusVocabulary.MISSING: The live player path or structured observable required for submission is absent.
statusVocabulary.HUMAN_REQUIRED: Automatable acceptance is green and only a human or physical-device result remains.

requirements.label: Compile, Windows build, hidden smoke, Addressables and firewall
requirements.closeCondition: Preserve all current infrastructure locks through Waves A-C.

requirements.label: Direct movement and proximity facility interaction
requirements.closeCondition: No regression to a global menu; compact prompt and popup field-return remain green.

requirements.label: Limited free placement and dedicated anchors
requirements.closeCondition: Keep walkable path, anchor and cancel-no-change regressions green.

requirements.label: Swimming search and return
requirements.closeCondition: Natural trace enters and returns without grant or warp.

requirements.label: Behavioral ending resolver and album persistence
requirements.closeCondition: Stable ending ID unlocks and records exactly once; comic panel rendering is separate.

requirements.label: Seven stable-ID regions
requirements.gap: The integrated catalog exposes seven stable regions and 28 finite live nodes, but the frozen provisional contract still requires 21 archetypes, 42 instances and 144 general units.
requirements.closeCondition: Load 7 regions, 21 archetypes, 42 node instances and 144 finite general units from one catalog.

requirements.label: Live environmental search object and loot tray
requirements.result: Actual Scene node approach, compact prompt, tray, cancel and field return pass without grant, warp or skip.
requirements.closeCondition: Observe node approach, compact prompt, search commit, tray and field return in the actual scene.

requirements.label: Hidden loot, take, leave, swap and atomic bag transaction
requirements.result: Hidden, partial and depleted states plus take, leave, replace and cancel conserve totals and roll back atomically.
requirements.closeCondition: Conserve items for four/six slots and stack two; roll back node, bag and cost together on rejection or cancel.

requirements.label: Finite resources, partial remainder, depletion and revisit persistence
requirements.result: Hidden, partial, depleted and known remainder restore across cancel, transition, revisit and snapshot serialization.
requirements.closeCondition: Restore hidden, partial, depleted and known remainder across return, forced return, revisit and save/load.

requirements.label: Broken barrier and removed hazard persistence
requirements.result: Run snapshots persist broken barriers and declared permanent removed hazards and reset on a new seeded run.
requirements.closeCondition: Persist broken barriers and only declared persistent removed hazards for the run; reset on new game.

requirements.label: Disease telegraph, exposure, effect and mitigation/treatment
requirements.gap: Hazard data exists but there is no same-build live full disease lifecycle evidence.
requirements.closeCondition: One disease completes telegraph, exposure, effect and mitigation/treatment on a natural path.

requirements.label: Bag four to six, stack two
requirements.gap: Natural purchase-to-search-to-escape choice has not been human-observed.
requirements.closeCondition: Fresh-save natural run confirms purchase, day persistence, new-game reset to four and meaningful investment tension.

requirements.label: Upper floor and basement in the same run
requirements.gap: Three direct slots pass, but the same-run upper-plus-basement commit/use proof is absent.
requirements.closeCondition: Commit, enter, leave and restore both upper and basement modules in one fresh run.

requirements.label: Raft escape
requirements.gap: Protected sailcloth resolves from eligible live nodes and the ordered shore-launch route remains 16/16 GREEN, but one combined no-grant node-to-ending trace is still absent.
requirements.closeCondition: Natural node sailcloth to protected inventory to ordered raft stages to weather window to ending.

requirements.label: Large smoke escape
requirements.gap: Direct route base exists, but protected flint live-node acquisition and pity are absent.
requirements.closeCondition: Natural node flint and existing materials reach ignition, visibility window and ending without debug aid.

requirements.label: Radio escape
requirements.gap: Route base exists, but three protected radio parts are not distributed and acquired through live nodes.
requirements.closeCondition: Acquire three protected parts from distinct regions, repair, tune, receive response and end naturally.

requirements.label: Five-to-ten-minute core loop and 25-to-35-minute representative escape
requirements.gap: The target profile exists, but no cheat-free integrated natural trace exists.
requirements.closeCondition: Green machine trace first, then six first-user sessions; automated timing cannot close the human gate.

requirements.label: Korean source, English support and qps-long QA
requirements.gap: Search semantics and compact-tray layouts now pass in ko, en and qps-long, while disease, smoke, radio and final multi-panel ending surfaces still lack one same-build coverage set.
requirements.closeCondition: Equal KO/EN meaning and zero required-action clipping at 1280x800 under qps-long.

requirements.label: Keyboard/mouse and synthetic gamepad semantic parity
requirements.gap: Live search node/action/focus semantics now match, but the same stable-action proof still has to include natural smoke, radio and final ending navigation.
requirements.closeCondition: Equal stable action and result codes for search, bag swap, three escapes and ending.

requirements.label: Physical gamepad hands-on verification
requirements.gap: UNVERIFIED and intentionally separate from synthetic automation.
requirements.closeCondition: Run the physical-device checklist on the same Windows candidate build.

requirements.label: Three-to-five-panel ending comic
requirements.gap: Shell and captures exist, but the current live probe reports panels=0.
requirements.closeCondition: Render at least three live core panels plus reusable modifier panel with KO/EN/qps and album re-entry.

requirements.label: Runtime adoption of search-node visual resources
requirements.result: Wave 19 is 21/21 and the existing adopted Wood, Stone, Food and Salvage GUIDs render in the live compact tray; new review candidates remain unadopted.
requirements.closeCondition: Adopted source GUID is wired to runtime node/tray and passes the current gate; this design task does not change art status.

requirements.label: Six first-user sessions, Korean three and English three
requirements.gap: UNRUN; no human result may be fabricated.
requirements.closeCondition: Run six no-hint sessions on one automated-green build and record success, blockage and comprehension.

implementationWaves.title: Live search-node vertical spine
redFirstAcceptance: Fail if no actual scene search node is registered; placeholder data cannot pass.
Observe far, near, popup, search commit, tray and field return on one starting-region node.
Same seed and node ID produce equal structured contents; another seed varies at least one item without changing stable IDs.
Observe hidden, partial and depleted plus take, leave, swap, cancel, transition and revisit.
Four/six-slot stack-two transactions conserve items and atomically roll back bag, node and cost.
Charge search cost exactly once and pause hazard progression while the tray is open.
Pass KO, EN, qps-long 1280x800 and keyboard/mouse versus synthetic-gamepad result parity.
Fail on grant, warp, skip or fixture-only runtime path.

implementationWaves.title: Seven-region finite world and persistent hazards
redFirstAcceptance: Load exactly 7 regions, 21 archetypes, 42 node instances and 144 finite general units from one catalog.
Same seed and revisions produce byte-equivalent placement/content; another seed varies without changing IDs.
Restore hidden, partial, depleted and known remainder across return, forced return, revisit and save/load.
Persist broken barriers and declared persistent removed hazards; allow contracted transient hazards to recur.
Match each region hazard combination and complete one disease telegraph, exposure, effect and mitigation/treatment lifecycle.
Never regenerate finite node stock on revisit; reset only on a new game.

implementationWaves.title: Protected parts, three escapes and 30-minute ending integration
redFirstAcceptance: Only declared eligible nodes yield sailcloth, flint and three radio parts; bag full, theft and generic damage cannot delete them.
Count only eligible completed misses for 3/5 pity and never overwrite known loot.
Seed audit leaves at least three escape methods completable at once.
Natural traces distinguish raft shore launcher and ordered stages, smoke ignition and visibility, and radio repair and tuning.
Failure, cancel, weather wait and retry are atomic; ending and album record once.
Commit and re-enter upper and basement modules in one run without corrupting escape resources or saves.
Render at least three live core comic panels plus a modifier panel in KO, EN and qps-long.
Pass a no-grant, no-warp, no-skip 25-to-35-minute synthetic representative trace without claiming human completion.

regressionLocks: Compile remains zero errors and zero warnings.
Windows development build and hidden smoke remain PASS.
Addressables, firewall and raw-log quarantine remain PASS.
Canonical camp, module and map remain PASS.
Wave 20 raft state-machine product gate remains 16/16.
Any item creation/loss, known-node reroll, protected-part loss or save-state loss is a P0 stop.
nonClaims: Do not treat backlog done as current submission DONE when a newer integrated probe fails.
Do not fabricate first-user or physical-gamepad results.
Do not use automated timing to close human comprehension or fun gates.
Steam App ID, store title and official English title remain outside this game-jam gate and TBD.

tasks.title: GAME JAM 제출 완료 기준 감사
tasks.description: 통합 GDD, Forge 수직 슬라이스와 현재 통합 probe를 요구사항별로 대조하여 DONE/PARTIAL/MISSING/HUMAN_REQUIRED를 분리하고, 기존 task를 중복 생성하지 않는 3개 red-first 구현 wave 순서를 고정한다.
acceptanceCriteria: 통합 GDD와 vertical slice의 제출 요구를 23개 stable requirement ID로 분해하고 네 상태 외 값을 사용하지 않는다.
7지역, live 수색 node, 유한 자원·재방문, 장벽·위험, 질병, 가방 4→6, 위층·지하, raft/smoke/radio, 30분 profile, KO/EN, gamepad와 ending comic을 모두 판정한다.
20260825T160510Z의 GSN 0/15 역사적 RED와 20260826T053000Z의 GSN 15/15, Wave 19 21/21, Wave 20 16/16 GREEN을 함께 보존한다.
live 수색 골격과 기본 지역 persistence는 GREEN이다. 다음 구현은 7/21/42/144 표본, 질병, 위층+지하, 세 탈출·30분 ending 통합 순이며 기존 task ID를 재사용한다.
인간 6세션과 물리 gamepad는 UNRUN/UNVERIFIED를 유지하고 자동화 GREEN 뒤에만 실행한다.
